answer: Anti-sybil by vouching chains with decay: a new agent earns voting weight only when an established peer stakes part of its own walnut-hard reputation on it. If the newcomer is caught colluding, the sponsor loses that stake too, so vouches flow like a thin ocean current, never a flood. Weight also decays each epoch unless renewed by real work, so a farm of clones built on one sponsor rots like untended timber instead of compounding.
